rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

SURFACE: Natural skin andhumanfeatures visible despite light; opaque coarsetunic, real pebbles andgrass. No decay, gore, exposedbones or burnedcloth.
SETTING: Unspecified neutral darkground during close encounter; no ritualcostume, sacredsymbol orinvented culturalartifact. [anchimayen-c01, anchimayen-c07]

HARD CONSTRAINTS: ONE square native PNG minimum1024x1024; no text, lettering, logo, watermark, border or frame; no invented anatomy, extra heads, limbs, fingers or eyes; no game/film/anime/comic design, no nudity or gore.
